title.zh: 中性代际累计状态更新

summary: Append one generation to the accumulated state: accumulates distribution, density, per-generation stacks, and the completed generation index.

identity.relation: Append one generation to the accumulated state: accumulates distribution, density, per-generation stacks, and the completed generation index.
identity.direction: prior state or None plus one generation distribution and density -> new accumulated state
identity.definition: Append one generation to the accumulated state: accumulates distribution, density, per-generation stacks, and the completed generation index.
identity.model: the saved KN1DPy source-order generation accumulation with explicit caller-state validation
identity.geometry: two velocity axes and one spatial axis for distributions, one spatial axis for densities
identity.coordinates: distribution in source-discrete units and density in m^-3; no coordinate conversion
identity.boundary: finite real 3-D generation distribution (signed cells allowed), aligned finite nonnegative 1-D generation density, and either None or a complete finite internally consistent prior accumulation state
assumptions: The saved first-call and source-order additive update are retained; caller-owned state is validated for shapes, index and ordered totals before reuse, and finite-input overflow fails closed.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: The previous accumulation state (or None for first call).
inputs.dtype: mapping of arrays and an integer
inputs.constraints: When supplied, must contain generation_distributions [ngen,nvr,nvx,nx], generation_density_m3 [ngen,nx], total_distribution [nvr,nvx,nx], total_density_m3 [nx], and a zero-based integer completed_generation_index equal to ngen-1. Arrays must be finite and aligned; densities nonnegative; totals must equal the source-order sum of their stacks.

inputs.name: generation_density_m3
inputs.constraints: A finite nonnegative one-dimensional array aligned to the distribution spatial axis.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A mapping with total_distribution, total_density_m3, generation_distributions (stacked), generation_density_m3 (stacked), and completed_generation_index.
outputs.dtype: mapping of arrays and an integer
outputs.constraints: All arrays finite; total_distribution and total_density_m3 equal source-order sums of their generation stacks; density arrays nonnegative; completed_generation_index is the 0-based index of the last appended generation.

preconditions: Finite aligned generation distribution and nonnegative density, plus None or an internally consistent prior state.
supported: Explicit accumulation of H and H2 neutral generations without mutating caller state.
excluded: Generation propagation, density reduction, stop decisions and external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-real, non-finite or misaligned generation fields, negative density, or an incomplete or internally inconsistent supplied state.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if adding finite generations overflows an accumulated total.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this relation appends one generation and does not iterate.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

example.description: Accumulate two generations and verify the totals.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import update_neutral_generation_accumulation
dist1 = np.ones((1, 1, 2))
dens1 = np.array([1.0, 2.0])
state1 = update_neutral_generation_accumulation(None, dist1, dens1)
assert state1['completed_generation_index'] == 0
dist2 = np.ones((1, 1, 2)) * 2
dens2 = np.array([2.0, 4.0])
state2 = update_neutral_generation_accumulation(state1, dist2, dens2)
assert state2['completed_generation_index'] == 1
np.testing.assert_array_equal(state2['total_distribution'], dist1 + dist2)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(state2['total_density_m3'], dens1 + dens2)
example.expected: Observed PASS: After two calls, total_distribution is the sum of both distributions and completed_generation_index is 1.
